newsitem.title: USA: BEC Group to acquire Bolle France.
newsitem.headline: BEC Group to acquire Bolle France.

text.p: BEC Group Inc said Monday it had signed a letter of intent to acquire SNC Bolle and affiliated companies, known collectively as Bolle France.
Terms of the transaction include cash consideration of about $60 million, BEC said.

The acquisition, which includes investments in Bolle distributors in Brazil, Canada, France, Japan and the United Kingdom, will be combined with Bolle America under a new company to be called Bolle Inc, BEC said.
Members of the Bolle family will also receive warrants to acquire 2.13 million shares of Bolle Inc, BEC said.

The warrants will allow the Bolle family to participate in 10 percent (prior to dilution from related financing and distributor acquisitions) of the increase in value from a negotiated current valuation of Bolle Inc's equity, net of purchase-related debt, of $3.10 per share, BEC said.
BEC said it expects the transaction to be accretive to earnings in the first year of combined operations.
Bolle France, based in Oyonnax, France, has manufactured sunglasses, sports shields, ski goggles, safety eyewear and related optical products for more than 50 years, BEC said.

BEC has two core businesses: the Optical Technologies Group, which manufactures and markets lighting, electronic and electroformed products; and Bolle America, the exclusive marketer and distributor of Bolle premium sunglasses, sports shields and goggles in the United States, Mexico and Costa Rica.
